title: Verb table and unit check sheet
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: The weekend; Basem in the village; the little mouse and the lion
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 7 (Verb table and unit check sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 7: Verbs in the past and present; unit check. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Basem in the past
points: شَرِبَ بَاسِمٌ الحَلِيبَ: Basem drank the milk

questions.q: Change to the past: يَلْعَبُ بَاسِمٌ فِي الحَقْلِ.
Core (unit check, portal response box or paper): 1) Match past and present: ذَهَبَ، كَتَبَ، شَرِبَ with يَشْرَبُ، يَذْهَبُ، يَكْتُبُ. 2) Write the weekend days. 3) Translate قَرْيَة and بَقَرَة.
questions.a: 1) ذَهَبَ يَذْهَبُ؛ كَتَبَ يَكْتُبُ؛ شَرِبَ يَشْرَبُ 2) السَّبْت وَالأَحَد 3) village, cow

questions.q: Extend: Write two sentences about Basem in the past.
questions.a: For example: ذَهَبَ بَاسِمٌ إِلَى القَرْيَةِ. شَرِبَ بَاسِمٌ الحَلِيبَ.

questions.q: Stretch: Write what Basem does now and what he did yesterday with one verb.
questions.a: For example: يَكْتُبُ بَاسِمٌ الآنَ. كَتَبَ بَاسِمٌ أَمْسِ.

questions.q: Which verb is in the past?
questions.a: B) كَتَبَ. كَتَبَ (he wrote) has no يَـ at the start: it is past.

questions.q: What does ذَهَبَ mean? A) he went B) he goes C) he plays
Big question: how does an Arabic verb show it already happened?
questions.a: The past form has no يَـ at the start, e.g. ذَهَبَ not يَذْهَبُ.
